1.explanation:
All three components inject a blank placeholder whenever iconOnly is true and no icon is provided:

• In src/nav/item.jsx, the code `if (iconOnly && !iconEl) { iconEl = <span className=...placeholder/> }` causes an empty icon slot for plain items.

• In src/nav/popup-item.jsx, in the same scenario (iconOnly && !iconEl && !hasArrow) it also inserts a placeholder node into the popup label array.

• In src/nav/sub-nav.jsx, likewise under iconOnly without an icon it creates a placeholder before the label.

To fix, these branches should be removed or guarded so that when iconOnly is set but no icon prop is passed, no placeholder is rendered, eliminating the blank spaces.
1.bug_scenario: In vertical Nav “iconOnly” mode, any Nav.Item, PopupItem or SubNav that doesn’t supply an explicit icon still renders an empty placeholder span. As a result, you see a blank icon block for items without an icon, and even in the popup menu an empty blank square before the label (highlighted in red). The fix is to prevent rendering that placeholder when no icon is configured.
